snippet.title: WarHeads (1997, PC) - Gameplay clips [No Commentary]
snippet.description:
Gameplay clips of WarHeads, a turn-based artillery game for Windows released in 1997. Like Worms, but in space, where the gravity of different planets affects your shots.

~~ 𝕋𝕠𝕠𝕝𝕤 𝕌𝕤𝕖𝕕 ~~
Game played using DOSBox-X with a Windows 95 setup.
Recorded with OBS Studio, edited with Shotcut.

~~ 𝔾𝕒𝕞𝕖 𝕊𝕠𝕦𝕣𝕔𝕖 ~~
Obtained from classicdosgames.

~~ 𝔸𝕓𝕠𝕦𝕥 𝕥𝕙𝕖 ℂ𝕙𝕒𝕟𝕟𝕖𝕝 ~~
No commentary gameplay. Just games, old and new, recorded for fun, nostalgia, maybe to inspire some game devs too, and discovery.
